data_source: real: first-corpus (D1) embeddings of the base and large encoders, relabelled with the D1 map, and second-corpus (D2; compilation `real` images, internal research corpus of real fingerprint images) embeddings of finger-vit and DeepPrint; finger-level flags from the per-image results of the worst-case training-overlap measurement; no synthetic data

d1.check: finger count overall and per source equal to d1_fingers.worst_case of the overlap measurement
d1.rule: a relabel-map finger is flagged when any of its labelled compilation images (the full key table: any impression, exclusion or partition) or any of its D1 images has its exact content key in candidate pool A; a pool key under several compilation identities flags each of them (the worst case)

d2.check: finger count overall and per source equal to the fingers at tau (d2.by_threshold) of the overlap measurement
d2.rule: a D2 finger is flagged when at least one of its D2 images has a maximum finger-vit cosine to candidate pool B (float64 maxima of the overlap measurement) of at least tau; DeepPrint uses the same split

pools.d1: candidate training pool A: extended dataset train split
pools.d2: candidate training pool B: packaged benchmark train split

question: do the encoders behave differently on the fingers absent from their candidate training pool (clean) than on size-matched samples of the fingers present in it (flagged)? No attack is run and no experiment changed

settings.auc: histogram AUC (label_check.hist_auc) over 4000 bins on [-1, 1]: P(genuine > impostor) plus half the probability that both fall in one bin
settings.composition_note: the pooled strata are confounded by source: a finger with k images contributes C(k, 2) genuine pairs, so sources with many images per finger dominate the genuine pairs, and the clean subset and the flagged subsamples mix the sources differently; composition gives, per stratum and source, the fingers and genuine pairs of the clean subset and their mean, minimum and maximum over the flagged subsamples
settings.control: DeepPrint is evaluated on the finger-vit split of D2; its documented training data does not include the D2 sources
settings.eer: ijiss_btp.eval.stats.eer (exact ROC interpolation), as in the experiments' utility rows
settings.embeddings: embeddings loaded as the experiments load them (ijiss_btp.experiments.isotropy.load_data, kind sin; D1 with its relabel map, rows without an identity dropped); raw space: each row L2-normalised; pre-key space: see prekey_rule; cosine similarity in both
settings.min_images_rule: fingers with at least 2 embedding rows, so that every finger has a genuine pair; the others are left out of both subsets
settings.pair_rule: all genuine pairs (every pair of rows of one finger) and `impostor_pairs` distinct pairs of rows of different fingers drawn uniformly at random (impostor_pairs of training_overlap.py), or every such pair when no more exist; both within the subset
settings.participation_ratio: participation ratio, (sum of eigenvalues)^2 / sum of squared eigenvalues of the covariance of the L2-normalised rows centred on their own mean (ijiss_btp.experiments.isotropy.spectrum_stats), on one seeded image per finger (samples = fingers) and on all images; computed in both spaces, because center_normalize L2-normalises every row after subtracting the DEV mean: the rows are rescaled by 1/||x - m|| instead of 1/||x||, and the subset-mean centring inside spectrum_stats removes only a common shift, so the two spaces can give different values; with n samples it cannot exceed min(n - 1, dim), and bounded_by_samples marks the entries where n - 1 < dim for the clean subset or a flagged subsample
settings.prekey_rule: for each encoder, the first seed's split of its main isotropy config (isotropy_<corpus>_<encoder>.yaml): make_split with the config's n_dev, n_tgt and min_tgt_images, as SeedContext of ijiss_btp.experiments.isotropy builds it; the mean of the split's DEV rows is subtracted from every embedding and each row is L2-normalised (center_normalize), which gives the experiments' pre-key embeddings; every statistic is then computed on the same fingers, images, pairs and seeds as in the raw space
settings.range_rule: the clean value against the mean of the flagged subsamples' values and their 2.5th to 97.5th percentiles (numpy.percentile, linear interpolation); clean_outside_flagged_range is descriptive, not a test
settings.seed_rule: stable_seed (ijiss_btp.experiments.isotropy) of (seed, corpus, stratum, subset, purpose); the encoder is not part of it, so the encoders of a corpus see the same fingers, images and pairs
settings.single_draw: each clean value is a single draw (one sample of impostor pairs and one seeded image per finger) with its own sampling error, which the flagged range does not include; clean_outside_flagged_range is descriptive, and a clean value just outside the range can fall inside it with another seed

spaces.prekey: experiments' pre-key space (DEV-mean centred, then L2-normalised)

settings.stratum_rule: all sources pooled, and every source with at least 100 eligible clean fingers; every stratum needs at least 2 clean fingers and at least as many flagged as clean ones
settings.subsample_rule: the clean subset of a stratum against `subsamples` random subsamples, without replacement, of the stratum's eligible flagged fingers, each of the clean subset's size
